description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller providing basic system endpoints such as health check, API info, and documentation redirect.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic system endpoints for health check, info, and documentation redirect.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation, preserving the request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health status response.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
